propositions: A manually-dispatched, digest-pinned GitHub Actions workflow must interrogate a pinned Jira DC amd64-only image (unavailable on arm64 dev hosts) and produce a committed environment contract artifact containing structured vocabulary mappings, field inventory, screen configuration, and REST operation validation results, with raw request/response evidence traceable to each claim.

The workflow must validate four independent vocabularies (issue types, statuses/workflows, priorities, link types) against hardcoded rebar mappings, including bidirectional link-type direction experiments, to detect silent failures that exist-but-unreachable statuses or inverted link directions cause.

Field length limits (summary 254, label 255, description 32767, comment 32767, ADF description 32000 chars) and the configurable instance property jira.text.field.character.limit must be measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back comparison to detect silent truncation, not inferred from successful writes.

The workflow must run only on workflow_dispatch (never push/PR/schedule), must use REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1 to prevent mutations, must pin the image digest by reading the Dockerfile FROM line to prevent staleness, and must assert these constraints in unit tests rather than relying on configuration alone.

The committed contract and all raw evidence must be consumed by harness setup assertion (not re-derived at test time), and the artifact's provenance (reported digest) must be verifiable against the actual pinned image to detect map staleness across re-pins.

The tool must answer specific falsifier questions from tickets 37e7 (parent-link editmeta operations and field vs. update semantics) and 1a9f (sub-task parent PUT vs. field write behavior) by executing deterministic REST operations and recording raw responses as evidence on those tickets.
